requirements.description: Monthly stock returns, prices and shares outstanding for the CRSP universe 1963-2014 (universe_common_stock_exchanges, var_me_crsp, T2-T6 portfolio returns and T1 ME)
Daily stock returns for realized variance (var_vol_managed, T6 volatility-managed portfolios)
Delisting returns and codes for Shumway -30% substitution and Cohen et al. proration (delisting_for_cause_missing_ret, delisting_prorate, T2 Panel D)

Point-in-time share codes, exchange codes and SIC codes for the common-stock NYSE/AMEX/Nasdaq universe and the financials/utilities exclusion (universe_common_stock_exchanges, universe_exclude_financials_utilities)
Annual Compustat fundamentals for book equity, ROE, sales growth, payout and the duration recursion (var_be_*, var_roe, var_sales_g, var_pr, var_dur_clean_surplus, all tables)
CRSP-Compustat link table for merging funda data onto CRSP permnos (all Compustat-based tables)
Fama-French 3/4/5 factors, momentum and risk-free rate, monthly, 1963-2014 (factor_ff5_mom_tbill_source, factor_definitions, T3/T6/T11/T12)
Thomson Reuters 13F institutional holdings for IOR and RIOR (var_ior, var_ior_zero, var_ior_carryforward, var_rior, T1 IOR cells, T10-T12)
I/B/E/S LTG forecasts, EPS actuals and analyst estimates for Table 8 (avail_ibes_sample_period, avail_ltg_nonmissing, C4)
I/B/E/S consensus price targets for Table 9 Panel A (sample_period_restrictions, C4)
Baker-Wurgler (2006) investor sentiment index for Table 7 and Table 9 Panels B/C (var_sentiment_high_low, sample_period_sentiment, claim C3)

Hand-collected Moody's manual book equity from Davis et al. (2000) used to supplement Compustat BE (avail_moodys_book_equity; affects BE and therefore the duration recursion for pre-1980 firms with missing Compustat BE)

blocking_issues.reason: The Baker-Wurgler (2006) sentiment index (monthly, 1965-2010) is not present anywhere in the ClickHouse catalog (no sentiment tables or columns). Table 7 is therefore not committed, claim C3 is documented as a data limitation, and Table 9 commits Panel A only (Panels B/C need the sentiment split).
blocking_issues.recommendation: Obtain the Baker-Wurgler sentiment index (Jeffrey Wurgler's website) and load it into ClickHouse, or accept the documented exclusion of Table 7 and Table 9 Panels B/C (claim C3 recorded as data-limited in assumptions.md).

blocking_issues.reason: The hand-collected Moody's manual book-equity data used in Davis et al. (2000), which Weber (2018) uses to supplement Compustat book equity, is not in the catalog. The substitution is Compustat-only BE (with the paper's redemption/liquidation/par preferred-stock cascade). This drops firm-years whose BE exists only in Moody's (mainly pre-1980) from BE-dependent variables, including the duration recursion (BV in Eq. 3) and BM.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Use Compustat-only BE and document the substitution in assumptions.md with an empirical vintage check (firm-year counts by decade before/after the BE cascade). If Moody's data becomes available, load it and re-run.

blocking_issues.reason: No single table carries all 7 factors; ff.five_factor_monthly has Mkt-RF/SMB/HML/RMW/CMA/RF (1963-07 to 2025-10) and ff.four_factor_monthly has Mkt-RF/SMB/HML/RF/Mom (1926-07 to 2025-10). The substitution is a join on dt of the two tables (Mom from four_factor_monthly).
blocking_issues.recommendation: Join ff.five_factor_monthly and ff.four_factor_monthly on dt; use Mom from four_factor_monthly for the FF4 (3F+MOM) specification.

blocking_issues.reason: det_epsus carries LTG (measure/fpi/value) and EPS detail estimates; actuals live in act_epsus and summary statistics in statsum_epsus. The substitution is a three-table join on ticker+cusip+date keys (documented in assumptions.md).
blocking_issues.recommendation: Join det_epsus (LTG from June statistical periods), act_epsus (realized annual EPS) and statsum_epsus (analyst means for SUE3) by ticker/cusip and period.

blocking_issues.reason: ptgsum columns were not enumerated in the catalog snapshot (table exists, 4.4M rows); expected WRDS ptgsum schema (ticker, cusip, statpers, numest, medest/meanest...) will be verified against the live schema at build time. Substitution: ptgdet or the enumerated ptgsum columns.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Verify ptgsum's live columns in ClickHouse at build time and use the consensus (median/mean) target price for June statistical periods; if ptgsum is unusable, fall back to ptgdet detail targets aggregated to consensus.
